items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: His brother was, Will Ridley was a trombone player.

ctx.x: Did you know Manuel Ridley? Yeah, Manuel Ridley, yeah, I know him.

His brother was, Will Ridley was a trombone player. Manuel Ridley was running a business for Farbacher at Rand Fortin Common. You played that there? Yeah, I played up there on the sort of a dance hall upstairs. Oh yeah? Over there. I played there quite often.
